Ticket:
Real-time insurance eligibility verification timeouts

Good morning, we are currently trying to run our batch of real-time insurance eligibility checks for tomorrow's scheduled appointments. However, several of our commercial payer verifications are timing out or returning connectivity errors when we query the clearinghouse. We have already verified our internet connection and restarted the workstation client. Could you please check if there are any known gateway issues with the eligibility service on your end today?
